title: Analysis of San Augustine, New Mexico crash wreckage
summary: Steve tells of Analysis of San Augustine, New Mexico crash wreckage, about 1947 crash; analysis undated at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Um, well, I I analyzed some of the um the wreckage from the San Augustine, New Mexico UFO crash

plain: A guest identified as Steve, on Jesse Michels' podcast about a scientist who studies alleged alien implants, says he analyzed some of the wreckage from a UFO crash at San Augustine, New Mexico. That crash is said to have happened in 1947, though he does not say when he did the analysis. If true, it would mean physical pieces of a crashed craft exist and have been studied.
